canonical_name: Tonelli's existence theorem in the calculus of variations
canonical_statement: For an admissible class of curves with fixed boundary data, an integral functional whose Lagrangian satisfies the applicable Tonelli regularity, convexity in velocity, and coercive growth hypotheses attains its infimum on that class.
domain_and_universes: Provisional: E : Type u with NormedAddCommGroup E and NormedSpace Real E; curves Real -> E; exact admissible function space and interval remain to be fixed from a primary source.
quantifiers: E : Type u with real normed-space structure
hypotheses: nonempty admissible class with boundary conditions
lower-semicontinuity/regularity of the Lagrangian and action
coercive growth sufficient for compactness of minimizing sequences
closure or weak sequential closure of the admissible class
conclusion: There is an admissible curve minimizing the action over the admissible class.

alternate_encodings.target: existence of u in A with forall v in A, I u <= I v

excluded_degenerate_cases: Empty admissible classes are excluded. Infinite action, extended-real codomain, interval endpoints, Sobolev representatives, and autonomous versus time-dependent variants are unresolved scope choices, not silently excluded theorem cases.
